MUTUAL NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT

THIS AGREEMENT IS MADE ON 2 SEPTEMBER 2026 BETWEEN:

(1) THE MARSDEN COMPUTATIONAL NEUROSCIENCE LAB, UNIVERSITY OF ASHFORD
    ("THE UNIVERSITY"); AND
(2) SYNAPTIQ BIO LIMITED, REGISTERED IN SCOTLAND NO. SC601447 ("SYNAPTIQ").

1. PURPOSE. THE PARTIES WISH TO EXCHANGE INFORMATION FOR THE PURPOSE OF
   EVALUATING A POSSIBLE RESEARCH COLLABORATION ON EEG SIGNAL DECODING
   ("THE PURPOSE").

2. CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. MEANS ALL INFORMATION DISCLOSED BY ONE PARTY TO
   THE OTHER, WHETHER ORALLY OR IN WRITING, THAT IS MARKED CONFIDENTIAL OR
   WOULD REASONABLY BE UNDERSTOOD TO BE CONFIDENTIAL, INCLUDING UNPUBLISHED
   DATASETS, SOURCE CODE AND EXPERIMENTAL PROTOCOLS.

3. OBLIGATIONS. EACH RECEIVING PARTY SHALL (A) USE CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION
   ONLY FOR THE PURPOSE; (B) NOT DISCLOSE IT TO ANY THIRD PARTY EXCEPT ITS
   EMPLOYEES AND STUDENTS WHO NEED TO KNOW AND ARE BOUND BY EQUIVALENT
   OBLIGATIONS; AND (C) PROTECT IT WITH AT LEAST REASONABLE CARE.

4. EXCLUSIONS. OBLIGATIONS DO NOT APPLY TO INFORMATION THAT IS PUBLICLY
   AVAILABLE, ALREADY KNOWN TO THE RECIPIENT, OR INDEPENDENTLY DEVELOPED.

5. ACADEMIC PUBLICATION. NOTHING IN THIS AGREEMENT PREVENTS THE UNIVERSITY
   FROM PUBLISHING RESULTS, PROVIDED SYNAPTIQ IS GIVEN 30 DAYS TO REVIEW ANY
   MANUSCRIPT FOR ITS CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION.

6. TERM. THIS AGREEMENT LASTS TWO (2) YEARS; OBLIGATIONS SURVIVE FOR FIVE (5)
   YEARS AFTER TERMINATION.

7. GOVERNING LAW. ENGLAND AND WALES.

SIGNED FOR THE UNIVERSITY: Dr H. Marsden       DATE: 02/09/2026
SIGNED FOR SYNAPTIQ:       C. Abernethy, CEO   DATE: 04/09/2026
